title: Statifier conformance exclusions
description: conformance/exclusions.json: the upstream SCION and W3C documents left out of the corpus, each with its reason atom and its reason. Generated by the emitter from this repository's exclusion lists and never edited by hand (ADR-0070). An empty exclusions file is a defect.

key.description: What is excluded, in the upstream's own naming: a W3C test id (e.g. "test201"), a SCION test directory (every case under it), or a SCION directory/name pair (one case).

reason.description: The reason atom, without its leading colon.

adr.description: The number of the decision record the prose cites (ADR-0026 is 26); present only when the prose cites one.
